name: Slime
description: Oozes closer, then can leap along a line for a crushing slam.

name: Skeleton
description: Rattling bones armed with a random weapon.

name: Skeleton Archer
description: Keeps distance with a bow — loads, then fires in straight lines.

name: Mimic
description: Disguised as a chest until disturbed.

name: Douvlon
description: A paired threat — red and blue share one life; the line between them cuts deep.

name: Mystic Core
description: A floating crystal that strikes at range or slips away.

name: Rockling
description: A stony brute with a tough hide.

name: Shadow Rodent
description: Moves twice and bites hard — attack and movement in any order.

name: Corrupted Shade
description: A shadow that hunts with stolen knowledge of battle. Draws from its own dark deck each turn.

name: Elite Skeleton
description: A seasoned warrior that spawns above the current threat level. Picks its best weapon and retreats when wounded.

name: Vineshon
description: Vine whip pulls prey close, then lashes for light damage.

name: Tangleweed Bloom
description: Roots spread tangleweed across the floor.

name: Drosir
description: Aquatic predator — glides through water to strike.

name: Beetle
description: Chitinous skitterer that flees when badly hurt.
